items.definition:
a person responsible for the supervision of a particular place or thing
The prison warden was very strict.

a distortion or twist in shape
The heat caused the wood to warp.

the uterus
The baby develops in the mother's womb.

a person who does not believe in God or gods
She identifies as an atheist and does not follow any religion.

the capacity for data transfer
We need more bandwidth to stream high-definition videos.

a membranous sac in animals that stores urine
The human bladder can hold a significant amount of liquid.

an entry recording an amount owed
Please check your bank statement for the debit transaction.

the action or process of demolishing
The old building is scheduled for demolition next month.

a prolonged quarrel
The two families had a long-standing feud.

a safety device
The lights went out because a fuse blew.

unnecessary excitement or activity
Don't make a fuss over such a small thing.

a protein found in grains
Many people avoid foods containing gluten.

a person or thing of great weight or importance
He is a heavyweight champion in boxing.

a person who makes laws
The lawmakers debated the new bill.

a type of aquatic plant
The lotus flower is a symbol of purity.

a sentimental longing for the past
He felt a wave of nostalgia for his childhood.

a low upholstered seat or footstool
She rested her feet on the ottoman.

a light, open building or structure used for shelter, concerts, or exhibitions
We took shelter from the rain under the park pavilion.

an advantage or benefit that you get because of your job
Free coffee is a nice perk of working here.

a person or body that supervises and controls a system or industry
The government appointed a new financial regulator.

the act of deliberately destroying, damaging, or obstructing something
The police suspected sabotage was behind the factory fire.

the use of irony to mock or convey contempt
Her voice was full of sarcasm when she thanked him.

a cessation of operation or activity
The government shutdown affected many public services.

a current score or total
Keep a tally of the votes as they come in.

a mixture of metals
Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin.

inflammation of a joint
My grandmother suffers from arthritis in her hands.

a large bundle of raw material
The farmer stacked the bales of hay.

a man or boy
He's a good chap, always willing to help.

a young male horse
The mare had a beautiful colt.

a part of a machine that turns, or an eccentric person
He turned the crank to start the engine.

an interruption of peace or order
There was a disturbance outside the bar.

an area that is fenced off or surrounded
The animals were kept in a large enclosure.

extreme scarcity of food
The country suffered a severe famine.

an expert or enthusiast in a specified field or activity
He's a computer geek; he knows everything about programming.

a disadvantage or impediment
His lack of experience was a significant handicap in the competition.

unfriendliness or opposition
There was open hostility between the two rival teams.

a religious song or poem of praise to God or a god
The choir sang a beautiful hymn during the service.

a blow that renders an opponent unconscious; a very attractive person
The boxer won the fight with a powerful knockout in the third round.

a person or place from which to keep watch; a watch
One person stayed on lookout while the others searched the area.

a typical example or pattern of something
The new discovery shifted the scientific paradigm.

an area of relatively level high ground
The hikers reached a high plateau after a long climb.

a district of a city or town
The police station is located in the central precinct.

the position or period of office of a prime minister or premier; a top division in sports
The team won the Premiership title last season.

the action or process of regenerating or being regenerated
The city council is focused on urban regeneration.

the action of remembering something
We observe a moment of silence in remembrance of those who died.

bitter indignation at having been treated unfairly
He felt a deep resentment towards his former boss.

a sticky flammable organic substance
The tree bark oozed a sticky resin.

a machine that simulates the controls and conditions of a vehicle or other device
Pilots train on a flight simulator.

a visually striking performance or display
The fireworks display was a magnificent spectacle.

a person's fixed or allotted period of work
He had a brief stint working in a restaurant.

the path followed by a projectile or object moving through space
The missile's trajectory was precisely calculated.

a state of dissatisfaction, disturbance, and agitation in a group of people, typically involving public demonstrations or disorder
The country was experiencing political unrest.

extreme physical or mental suffering
He was in agony after the accident.

a standard or point of reference against which things may be compared or assessed
This new product sets a new benchmark for quality.

a period of uncontrolled indulgence in an activity, especially eating or drinking
She went on a shopping binge.

a group of countries or political parties with common interests who have formed an alliance
The trade agreement was signed by the entire economic bloc.

savage physical violence or great cruelty
The police were accused of brutality.

a branch of mathematics concerned with rates of change and accumulation
She is studying calculus at university.

the most intense, exciting, or important point of something
The story reached its climax in the final chapter.

a fast sailing ship, or a tool for cutting
He used nail clippers to trim his fingernails.

the compartment for the pilot and crew in an aircraft or spacecraft
The pilot sat in the cockpit, preparing for takeoff.

a punctuation mark (:) used to introduce a list, quotation, or explanation
Remember to use a colon before a list of items.

a thin rubber sheath worn on the penis during sexual intercourse as a contraceptive or to prevent sexually transmitted infections
Using a condom can prevent unwanted pregnancies.

a person or group competing with others to achieve something
She is a strong contender for the championship title.
